sidebarintro: Anderson & Jahde has been solving tax problems for individuals, businesses, and professionals in Denver since 1995.
homeIntro: Individuals and businesses confronted with the ominous powers of the IRS and local taxing authorities face potentially serious consequences. The tax attorneys at Anderson & Jahde, including former IRS trial lawyers, have extensive experience handling civil and criminal tax disputes and trials. Since opening our doors in Denver, Colorado in 1995, our tax attorneys have solved countless tax problems with solutions as unique as each client.
